usage: codex_jobs.py cancel [-h] [--recovery] [--if-todo-ready --cancel-key KEY] [--todo-id ID] [--related-todo-ids IDS] [--todo-file PATH] [--no-action-check PATH] id

positional arguments:
  id

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
  --recovery  preserve the distinction from a deliberate owner stop
  --if-todo-ready  with --recovery, return JSON after checking dependencies under queue -> job state -> ToDo locks
  --todo-id ID  exact source task association for guarded cancellation
  --related-todo-ids IDS  comma-separated exact related task IDs
  --todo-file PATH  shared ToDo store (defaults to the configured store)
  --cancel-key KEY  durable recovery attempt ID; a previously committed attempt may finish after a later wait
  --no-action-check PATH  verify content-free idle proof, current worker/generation and frozen tool boundary before recovery
